training.log.title: This month
training.log.silva.m01: Arrives in Houston and, at the welcome lunch, asks each person why they are here. Becomes the group's host.
training.log.silva.m02: Struggles with life-support chemistry. Sato tutors him twice a week, and he passes the exam.
training.log.silva.m03: Feels at home in the NBL pool and calms Costa during her first dive, teaching her a breathing count.
training.log.silva.m04: Lower-back pain shows up on deadlifts. He hides it until the coach adapts the programme.
training.log.silva.m05: Completes the 6 G re-entry profile with a pilot's anti-G technique, and jokes on the radio. Reviews the technique with Costa.
training.log.silva.m06: In the Gulf survival exercise he organises the life raft and argues about pace with Ramírez.
training.log.silva.m07: On the robotic arm he hands control to Sato and learns that command also means delegating.
training.log.silva.m08: On the parabolic flight he feels no sickness. He films a video floating with his niece's rocket drawing.
training.log.silva.m09: In Arizona he tells stories of aeromedical evacuations around the campfire, with Haddad.
training.log.silva.m10: Takes over the duty roster in the isolation analog. Spends an afternoon quiet after a late letter from his mother.
training.log.silva.m11: Gets his amateur radio licence and makes the first contact with a school in Belém, his sister's school.
training.log.silva.m12: Is praised for his leadership at the midterm review. Practises gradual needle exposure with Costa.
training.log.silva.m13: In the six-hour pool runs he forms a fixed EVA pair with Sato: he takes navigation and timing.
training.log.silva.m14: During the life-support failures he halts the test when Costa gets a headache from high CO₂.
training.log.silva.m15: Spends Christmas in Belém and returns to the sims with communication delay, which annoys him at first.
training.log.silva.m16: Designs with the team the storm-shelter cards: large numbers and icons, easy to read under alarm.
training.log.silva.m17: In the 72-hour simulation he sleeps little and insists he is fine. The flight surgeon orders him to rest.
training.log.silva.m18: A wrong decision in a leak simulation leads to a public apology and a new disagreement protocol.
training.log.silva.m19: In the emergency drills he gives himself ten fingerstick glucose checks through the month, to overcome his fear of needles.
training.log.silva.m20: In the calibration interviews he asks the AI to ask about pain on a numeric scale.
training.log.silva.m21: On family day his mother and niece visit the hangar, and the girl sits in the simulator.
training.log.silva.m22: In the full missions he asks "does anyone see it differently?" before every critical decision.
training.log.silva.m23: Writes twenty-four letters for his niece, one for each month he plans to tell her about when he returns.
training.log.silva.m24: Plays chess with Sato every night in quarantine and is the first to board the spacecraft.
training.log.costa.m01: Moves to Houston with her family. She is surprised when Silva answers the lunch question in Portuguese.
training.log.costa.m02: Starts a crew health wiki and updates it every Friday. Sato corrects a chemical reaction in it.
training.log.costa.m03: On her first NBL dive her breathing speeds up and she asks to surface. On the second try she gets through.
training.log.costa.m04: Records everything carefully in the baseline tests. Tells the coach about Silva's posture, and he is upset for a day.
training.log.costa.m05: Has grey vision during the 6 G profile and leaves shaken. Trains the anti-G technique with Silva and passes the retest.
training.log.costa.m06: In the cold training she sets up hypothermia checks for everyone every 30 minutes.
training.log.costa.m07: On the robotic arm she works quietly with Sato and gets the best capture of the group.
training.log.costa.m08: Gets sick during the parabolic flight and logs the symptoms minute by minute. On the second day she completes the parabolas.
training.log.costa.m09: In Arizona she draws every outcrop and talks about desert medicine with Haddad.
training.log.costa.m10: Keeps a strict routine in the isolation analog. Notices Silva has been quiet and sits beside him without asking anything.
training.log.costa.m11: Takes three days off to be with her daughter, who had an anxiety crisis at school.
training.log.costa.m12: Teaches IV access in the medbay and suggests gradual needle exposure to Silva.
training.log.costa.m13: The rigid suit is too big for her and her shoulders hurt. The team adjusts it and she finishes the month pain-free.
training.log.costa.m14: Gets a headache at 1,200 ppm of CO₂, before the others. Silva stops the test, and she asks for an earlier warning.
training.log.costa.m15: Travels to Hamamatsu with her family at the end of the year. Back at the hangar, the delayed-communication sims no longer bother her.
training.log.costa.m16: Teaches dosimetry to the group and adds dose readings to the shelter cards.
training.log.costa.m17: In the 72-hour simulation she orders Silva to rest, using her medical authority.
training.log.costa.m18: Speaks with Sato and Silva one-to-one before the mediation and helps write the disagreement protocol.
training.log.costa.m19: Runs the medical emergency drills and trains Silva and Sato as crew medical officers.
training.log.costa.m20: In the calibration interviews she lists her preferences and asks the AI to warn her at 1,100 ppm.
training.log.costa.m21: Her parents visit Houston for family day and talk for hours with Silva's family.
training.log.costa.m22: In the full missions she works calmly, with short medical briefings with Silva.
training.log.costa.m23: Says goodbye to her family at the airport and spends a few minutes alone in the car before returning to the hangar.
training.log.costa.m24: Records bedtime stories for her son and puts together the piano playlist with Sato. Cooks the last dinner with Silva.
training.log.sato.m01: At the welcome lunch he answers Silva in a single sentence. Silva does not push, and Sato notices.
training.log.sato.m02: He is the reference in life support. He teaches at the mess whiteboard, with diagrams and gardening analogies.
training.log.sato.m03: In the NBL he moves with a climber's precision, and the instructor uses him as a demonstrator.
training.log.sato.m04: Baseline tests show old signs in his right shoulder. He follows the prevention programme alone, in the evenings.
training.log.sato.m05: Feels mild nausea on re-entry and says nothing; he reports it only when asked directly.
training.log.sato.m06: In the cold training he builds the shelter everyone uses. He hardly speaks.
training.log.sato.m07: On the robotic arm he works with Costa. The two exchange only numbers and get the best capture.
training.log.sato.m08: On the parabolic flight he does somersaults and laughs out loud with Silva. He records the aircraft's sounds for music.
training.log.sato.m09: In Arizona he explains mineral chemistry and tells Okafor the story of his grandmother's greenhouse.
training.log.sato.m10: Withdraws and eats alone for a few weeks. Costa says he is only recharging.
training.log.sato.m11: Takes a weekend away from the base and comes back with homemade kombucha for the group.
training.log.sato.m12: Gets the top technical score, but is asked to speak up more in the group.
training.log.sato.m13: His right shoulder hurts after overhead work. When asked, he answers with a number, and he becomes Silva's fixed EVA partner.
training.log.sato.m14: Finds the CO₂ scrubber fault in under two minutes and matches Costa's headache with the sensor data.
training.log.sato.m15: Spends the new year with his family and asks for his grandmother's shiso seeds to be planted in the garden lab.
training.log.sato.m16: Calculates the shelter's water wall and proposes potable water bags as mobile shielding.
training.log.sato.m17: Drinks five coffees a day in the 72-hour simulation. Accepts the sleep data Costa shows him.
training.log.sato.m18: Disagrees with a decision of Silva's, withdraws for a week, then joins the mediation.
training.log.sato.m19: In the medical drills he draws blood from Silva while talking about chess to distract him.
training.log.sato.m20: Answers the technical questions of the calibration and asks for the data policy in writing before finishing.
training.log.sato.m21: On family day the greyhound Sputnik is the star, and he patiently answers Ren's questions.
training.log.sato.m22: Uses the disagreement protocol: he says one sentence, and Silva repeats it before deciding.
training.log.sato.m23: Is cleared for his shoulder, with the maintenance plan for the flight.
training.log.sato.m24: Plays chess with Silva every night and sets up Costa's piano playlist.
